text:
Carmen: Big public kudos to @Ezra and @Carmen for tonight's 'deploy + cookies' double rescue. You two saved the demo and our will to survive. :trophy::cookie:
Ezra: Credit mostly to Carmen  I stomped on the weird flaky test, but Carmen sprinted home and baked cookies for the on-call crew while I was neck-deep in logs.
Carmen: I will accept the title of "baker of last resort". Also sneaked a 2-page quick-deploy checklist into the repo at the 11th hour. Hope it helps future panics. :floppy_disk:
Jin: The checklist is gold. Read it mid-frenzy and it literally stopped me from toggling the wrong flag. Carmen, cookies + docs = immortal. :raised_hands:
Ezra: The flaky test was an interaction between the feature flag and a stale cache shard. Fixed the shard eviction order, added a regression unit test, and pinned the flag for the rollout.
People-Ops: We're sending Carmen a 'First Responder' mug and emailing both Carmen and Ezra a $30 dinner voucher. Also putting the checklist in the onboarding folder and highlighting it in the weekly digest.
Kitchen-Bot: Restock log: 2027-01-22T23:04:12Z - cookies replenished by Carmen (12 chocolate chip). Remaining snacks: 7. :biscuit:
Facilities: We'll add a laminated copy of the 2-page checklist to the on-call binder in the server room and tape a mini laminated version to the inside of the ops cabinet.
Jin: Can we add a 60-second walkthrough video to go with the checklist? I volunteer to record a screen capture tomorrow and pin it.
Carmen: Love that. Also, for the record, the secret ingredient is patience and slightly-too-melted butter.
Ezra: Noted for posterity. Also, pro tip added to the checklist: when in doubt, run the cache compact script before toggling flags.
People-Ops: Small ask: can we get a quick PR template for emergency patches so the wording and rollback steps are standardized? That would be a nice companion to Carmen's checklist.
Ezra: I'll draft it and drop it in #eng-ops tonight.
Jin: Cake next time? Cookies are dangerous but tasty. :wink:
Carmen: I will bring brownies if Ezra promises not to push at 11pm on a Friday. Deal?
Ezra: Deal. Thanks everyone for the quick teamwork. Feels good to shout out the tiny rescues that keep things moving. :sparkles:
